messages:
kate (Finance): Quick update — tomorrow at 09:00 PT we'll deploy a change to metering precision and free-credit eligibility. This is mostly a backend rounding + eligibility-window tweak, not a price change. See the internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/metering-precision

sara (Product): TL;DR for customers? will invoices look different?

kate (Finance): Short answer: some invoices may show tiny per-minute adjustments (<= $0.02 per customer) for high-frequency customers. Eligibility for promotional credits now requires 3 days of active usage within the first 14 days (was 1). We're doing this to reduce credit abuse.

mike (Eng): The metering change is: switch from a 60s-aligned bucket to true per-minute single-second resolution, and we changed rounding to floor at 0.0001 token units. Config flag is `meter_resolution=1s` in prod. Rollout will be phased by region.

ops-bot: Deployment window scheduled: 2026-04-10 09:00 PT → 09:30 PT. Canary in us-west-2, then global. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/billing-metering-rollout

tasha (Support): Support playbook ready? Any scripts to reconcile customer concerns?

kate (Finance): Yes — support checklist added to the doc. Quick guidance: if customers ask, explain it's a precision/eligibility update not a rate increase; offer to run a one-off invoice diff projection for impacted customers.

sara (Product): Are partners affected (marketplace customers)?

mike (Eng): Marketplace metering will inherit the same resolution; partner passes will be flagged and we have a small grace reconciliation job that will run during the first week.

kate (Finance): Action items: 1) Announce externally after rollout completes (PR scheduled) 2) Support to use checklist for any billing tickets 3) Finance to run a smoke diff on top 200 accounts post-canary.

ops-bot: Canary completed (us-west-2). No regressions. Proceeding to staged global rollout. :white_check_mark:

tasha (Support): Copy that — will watch #support and escalate if we see anomalous invoice diffs.

sara (Product): Thanks team. I'll draft the short external note emphasizing stability and fairness. :thumbsup:

kate (Finance): Thanks — ping me if you need example language for outreach.
